Concentration name: Intelligence, Global Security, Cyber Security, Homeland Security
description: Northeastern University’s Master of Arts in Security and Intelligence Studies (MASIS) program prepares graduates to tackle the most complex challenges in security and intelligence today. Graduates are equipped with a strong theoretical understanding of security and intelligence topics, analytical skills, leadership, and operational capabilities needed to succeed in a wide range of roles. The MASIS curriculum prepares graduates for careers in international, national, state, and local security and intelligence agencies, as well as the private sector. The program offers a range of specialization options and experiential learning opportunities including the co-op program.
Program name: Master of Arts in Security and Intelligence Studies

description:
Become an Elementary Education teacher for grades 1-6 in a fully accredited program. Prepare for a promising career in teaching in just 15 months! The Master of Arts in Teaching (MAT) in Elementary Education program at Northeastern University’s College of Professional Studies prepares students to become licensed teachers of elementary education in Massachusetts, grades 1–6. The program is designed for current teachers, career changers, and recent college graduates who hold a bachelor’s degree but did not major in education, and who wish to obtain an initial teaching license. Our cohort-based MAT program is offered through a hybrid model, allowing students to learn both online and in person. Students attend synchronous classes one evening per week during the 15-month program. They also complete a full-time, yearlong internship (fall and spring semesters) in an elementary classroom, giving them practical experience from the start of their program.
Graduates of the Master of Arts in Teaching in Elementary Education program will be able to:
*   Understand and apply foundational knowledge about student development and learning differences to plan and implement effective instruction, assessment, and differentiation for students in grades 1–6.
*   Understand and apply foundational knowledge about social-emotional development and learning to create a safe, healthy, and supportive learning environment for all students in grades 1–6.
*   Understand and apply foundational knowledge about curriculum development, instructional design, and pedagogical practices to plan and implement engaging and effective instruction for students in grades 1–6.
*   Understand and apply foundational knowledge about assessment practices to monitor student learning, provide meaningful feedback, and make instructional adjustments for students in grades 1–6.
*   Understand and apply foundational knowledge about professional ethics, responsibilities, and reflective practices to engage in continuous professional growth and advocate for students and families in grades 1–6.
Accreditation status: Accredited by the New England Commission of Higher Education (NECHE).
Program name: Master of Arts in Teaching in Elementary Education

description:
The Master of Arts in Teaching (MAT) in Secondary Education prepares you to meet the needs of diverse learners and become a leader in urban secondary education. You will develop the pedagogical knowledge and skills to teach students in grades 8–12 through coursework grounded in justice-oriented, anti-racist, and asset-based frameworks. This program is for prospective educators seeking initial licensure in Massachusetts. After graduation, you’ll be prepared for roles as:
*   High school teachers
*   Department chairs
*   Instructional coaches
*   Curriculum developers
*   Education policy advocates
Program name: Master of Arts in Teaching in Secondary Education

description: The Master of Education (M.Ed.) is a graduate degree program designed for current and aspiring educators, administrators, and education professionals who want to develop new skills, expand their knowledge base, and advance their careers. The program combines theory and practice to help you develop the expertise needed to address the complex challenges facing education today. The Northeastern University College of Professional Studies (CPS) Master of Education program offers a flexible and customizable curriculum with a variety of specializations to meet your career goals. Whether you’re interested in curriculum and instruction, higher education administration, special education, or another area of education, the M.Ed. program can help you achieve your professional aspirations. The program is designed for working professionals, with online and hybrid courses that allow you to balance your studies with your personal and professional commitments.
Program name: Master of Education in Education

description: The Master of Education (MEd) in Higher Education Administration program prepares students to become leaders, policymakers, and practitioners in colleges and universities. The program is designed to provide students with the foundational knowledge of how higher education institutions operate, the cultural and political context in which they exist, and the challenges and opportunities facing the sector. Through a combination of academic study and practical experience, students will develop a deep understanding of higher education administration, including its history, current trends, and future directions. Students will also gain essential leadership and management skills, including the ability to communicate effectively, to lead diverse teams, to analyze complex data, and to make informed decisions that promote equity, inclusion, and student success. Graduates of the program will be prepared to work in a variety of settings within higher education, including academic affairs, student affairs, admissions, financial aid, institutional advancement, and policy development. The program emphasizes an experiential, problem-based approach to learning, allowing students to apply theoretical knowledge to real-world challenges faced by colleges and universities. Students will also have the opportunity to engage in research and scholarship, contributing to the broader field of higher education administration.
Program name: Master of Education in Higher Education Administration

Concentration name: Applied Analytics, Business Analytics, Cyber-Physical Systems, Data Science, Machine Learning
description: Our Master of Professional Studies in Analytics program helps you unlock the insights hidden in data to solve real-world challenges. Through an innovative, interdisciplinary curriculum, you’ll master the latest tools and techniques to collect, organize, interpret, and transform data into actionable strategies. The program offers a blend of theoretical knowledge and practical application, providing you with a strong foundation in statistical modeling, machine learning, data visualization, and predictive analytics. You’ll gain hands-on experience with industry-standard software and programming languages, preparing you for leadership roles in various sectors, including business, healthcare, finance, and technology.
Program name: Master of Professional Studies in Analytics

description: The Master of Professional Studies (MPS) in Applied Logistics at Northeastern University is designed for early- and mid-career professionals looking to enhance their analytical and decision-making capabilities within the logistics and supply chain management fields. This innovative program combines academic rigor with practical application, preparing graduates to tackle real-world challenges in a dynamic global marketplace. Students will explore core areas such as supply chain analytics, operations management, transportation logistics, and strategic sourcing. The curriculum is structured to provide a comprehensive understanding of complex logistics systems, emphasizing data-driven approaches and sustainable practices. Graduates will be equipped with the skills to optimize logistics operations, improve efficiency, and drive strategic value for organizations across various industries.
Program name: Master of Professional Studies in Applied Logistics

description: The Master of Professional Studies in Applied Machine Intelligence offers a unique blend of technical expertise and practical application, equipping students with the skills to design, develop, and deploy intelligent systems across various industries. Rooted in real-world problem-solving, this program emphasizes hands-on experience with cutting-edge tools and methodologies. Through a comprehensive curriculum spanning artificial intelligence, machine learning, data science, and ethical AI, students learn to transform data into actionable insights and innovative solutions. Graduates are prepared to lead in roles such as AI/ML Engineer, Data Scientist, Machine Learning Consultant, and AI Product Manager, driving the next generation of technological advancement.
Program name: Master of Professional Studies in Applied Machine Intelligence

description: The Master of Professional Studies in Digital Media program, offered by Northeastern’s College of Arts, Media and Design, is designed for those who want to advance their careers in the rapidly evolving fields of digital media and interactive design. Through an interdisciplinary curriculum, students develop expertise in a variety of digital media practices, including digital storytelling, content creation, user experience (UX) design, interactive media, and data visualization. The program emphasizes hands-on projects, critical thinking, and collaboration, preparing graduates to lead and innovate in areas such as digital marketing, web design, mobile application development, game design, and immersive media. Students gain practical experience with industry-standard tools and techniques while exploring the theoretical underpinnings of digital culture and communication. With a focus on both creative and strategic aspects of digital media, the program equips students with the skills and knowledge to navigate and shape the future of digital communication and experiences.
Program name: Master of Professional Studies in Digital Media

description:
The Digital Media–Connect MS is a 32-semester-hour program for students with limited experience in digital media. It is designed to prepare students for a wide range of jobs in digital media, from web design and development to user experience and interface design. The program emphasizes hands-on, project-based learning and collaboration, ensuring graduates are well-versed in the latest digital tools and technologies.
Students will learn how to design, develop, and manage digital media projects, including websites, mobile apps, and interactive experiences. They will also gain an understanding of digital media theory, research, and ethics. The program culminates in a capstone project, where students apply their skills to a real-world digital media problem.
The Digital Media–Connect MS is offered by the College of Arts, Media and Design at Northeastern University in Boston, Massachusetts. It is an ideal program for students who want to enter the digital media field but do not have a strong background in the area. Graduates of the program are well-prepared for careers as web designers, web developers, UX/UI designers, digital project managers, and digital media specialists.
Program name: Master of Professional Studies in Digital Media—Connect

description: Are you passionate about using data and technology to solve real-world problems? Do you want to lead the design, development, and implementation of innovative information systems? The Master of Professional Studies (MPS) in Informatics program from Northeastern University will equip you with the advanced technical skills and leadership competencies necessary to thrive in the dynamic and rapidly evolving field of informatics. Our interdisciplinary curriculum combines computer science, information science, and social sciences, providing a holistic understanding of how information systems interact with individuals, organizations, and society. You'll gain expertise in areas such as data analytics, artificial intelligence, cybersecurity, user experience (UX) design, and project management, preparing you for a wide range of career opportunities in diverse industries. With a strong emphasis on practical, hands-on learning, you’ll work on real-world projects and collaborate with industry partners, building a robust portfolio that showcases your abilities to potential employers. Our flexible program allows you to tailor your studies to your specific interests and career goals, with options for full-time or part-time enrollment and online or on-campus learning.
Program name: Master of Professional Studies in Informatics

description: The Master of Professional Studies in Insurance Analytics and Management program helps students develop the critical business acumen, technical skills, and industry knowledge needed to thrive in the evolving insurance field. Graduates of the program are able to make data-driven decisions that will help redefine the industry. Students in the program develop skills to transform large quantities of data into business intelligence that will contribute to successful business operations and strategy.
Program name: Master of Professional Studies in Insurance Analytics and Management

description:
The Master of Professional Studies in Learning Experience Design and Technology program focuses on a blend of learning sciences, user experience (UX) design, and educational technology. This program prepares students to become leaders in designing, developing, and implementing effective and engaging learning experiences across diverse contexts, including higher education, corporate training, K-12, and non-profit organizations. It emphasizes human-centered design principles and leverages technology to create innovative solutions to complex learning challenges.

Students in the program will:
* Apply learning theories, principles of human cognition, and instructional design models to create effective learning experiences.
* Master UX research and design methodologies to understand learner needs and optimize learning interactions.
* Evaluate and integrate emerging educational technologies to enhance learning environments.
* Design and develop technology-enhanced learning solutions, including digital courses, simulations, interactive tools, and virtual reality applications.
* Lead project teams in the design, development, and implementation of learning experience projects.
* Assess the impact and effectiveness of learning experiences using data-driven approaches.
* Develop professional portfolios showcasing their expertise in learning experience design and technology.
Program name: Master of Professional Studies in Learning Experience Design and Technology

description: Northeastern’s Master of Science in Commerce and Economic Development is designed for professionals eager to transform their career path into one focused on fostering global economic prosperity. You will examine the foundational principles of international commerce and trade, urban and regional development, public policy, and global competitiveness. Offered by the Department of Economics within the College of Social Sciences and Humanities, the MS in Commerce and Economic Development brings together academic rigor and hands-on, experience-based learning to give you a strong theoretical background paired with real-world experience through an optional co-op program, international field study opportunities, and more. This program prepares you to lead development initiatives as an economist or economic development professional across government, private, and nonprofit organizations. With opportunities to tailor your degree to your professional interests, the MS in Commerce and Economic Development provides you with the skills and knowledge needed to pursue a career in economic development and international commerce.
Program name: Master of Science in Commerce and Economic Development

description: In today’s globalized and digital world, the need for skilled communicators with a mastery of modern communication principles and techniques continues to grow. Northeastern University’s Master of Science in Corporate and Organizational Communication program will prepare you to be a dynamic leader and strategist capable of managing complex communication challenges within various organizational settings—from corporate, non-profit, and government organizations to educational institutions, advertising and public relations agencies, and more. This comprehensive communication master’s program will provide you with a foundation in communication theory and research, as well as an understanding of the impact of new technologies on organizational communication. You’ll acquire a core understanding of communication concepts while developing expertise in specific areas through a range of electives. Upon graduation, you’ll be equipped to develop, implement, and manage integrated communication strategies across multiple platforms and target audiences. In addition, you’ll be prepared to lead diverse teams, manage internal and external stakeholder relationships, and measure the effectiveness of communication initiatives. The MS in Corporate and Organizational Communication is offered by Northeastern University’s College of Professional Studies, one of the nation’s leaders in providing career-focused education for working professionals. This program is also available in an online format.
Program name: Master of Science in Corporate and Organizational Communication

Concentration name: Global Health, Global Justice and Human Rights, International Conflict and Cooperation, International Development and Environmental Policy, International Economics and Business
description: Northeastern’s Master of Science in Global Studies and International Relations program prepares you for careers in international affairs and related professions in government, the private sector, and nonprofit organizations. The curriculum provides a strong background in global issues and international relations and offers an opportunity to develop expertise in specialized areas through concentrations. You’ll gain critical analytical and research skills, a thorough grounding in the theories and methods of global studies, and the substantive knowledge needed to work effectively in a global environment. The program also offers opportunities for experiential learning through co-op and internship placements across the United States and around the world, as well as opportunities for study abroad and global research.
Program name: Master of Science in Global Studies and International Relations

description: As organizations navigate an ever-evolving global landscape, human resources (HR) professionals play a pivotal role in shaping cultures, driving innovation, and fostering employee success. Northeastern University’s Master of Science in Human Resources Management equips students with the advanced knowledge and skills to lead and transform HR functions in today’s dynamic business environment. Students will explore core HR disciplines, including talent acquisition and retention, organizational development and change, employee relations, compensation and benefits, HR technology, and diversity and inclusion. The program emphasizes strategic HR leadership, ethical decision-making, and data-driven approaches to solve complex organizational challenges. Designed for both experienced professionals seeking to advance their careers and individuals looking to enter the HR field, this program prepares graduates for leadership roles in various sectors, including corporate, non-profit, and government.
Program name: Master of Science in Human Resources Management

description: The Master of Science in Nonprofit Management program at Northeastern University prepares students with the strategic skills needed to lead a wide range of nonprofit organizations, including foundations, social enterprises, NGOs, advocacy groups, and cultural institutions. The program focuses on providing a comprehensive understanding of effective leadership, financial management, resource development, and strategic planning within the nonprofit sector. Graduates emerge prepared to tackle complex challenges, drive social change, and make a significant impact in their communities and globally.
Program name: Master of Science in Nonprofit Management
Master of Science in Organizational Leadership

description: The Master of Science in Project Management program at Northeastern University is designed to equip professionals with the advanced knowledge and practical skills necessary to lead complex projects across diverse industries. Students will delve into fundamental and advanced principles of project management, including strategic planning, robust execution, meticulous monitoring, and effective control and closing. The curriculum emphasizes critical areas such as agile methodologies, risk assessment and mitigation, stakeholder communication, resource management, and ethical leadership. Through a blend of rigorous academic study, experiential learning opportunities, and real-world case studies, graduates are prepared to navigate project challenges, drive innovation, and deliver successful outcomes in today’s global business environment. The program also aligns with the standards set by the Project Management Institute (PMI), helping to prepare students for the Project Management Professional (PMP) certification exam.
Program name: Master of Science in Project Management

description: Northeastern University’s Master of Science in Regulatory Affairs prepares students for leadership roles in the regulatory science field. Graduates will learn to manage the regulatory process for products regulated by agencies like the Food and Drug Administration (FDA) and international authorities. Taught by industry experts, the curriculum focuses on quality assurance, clinical research, and regulatory strategy. This program is offered on-campus and online and is available to both full- and part-time students.
Program name: Master of Science in Regulatory Affairs

description: Take your place at the nexus of sports and business with Northeastern’s Master of Sports Leadership, offered by the College of Professional Studies in Boston. You’ll be immersed in the most current issues in sports, including sports law, marketing, finance, and analytics. As you develop the strong leadership skills necessary to succeed in a complex global industry, you’ll also focus on ethical decision-making, social responsibility, and creating an inclusive environment in sports. Our curriculum is designed to give you a broad-based foundation for a career in management, leadership, or operations within a wide range of sports organizations. Taught by faculty with extensive experience in the field, this program includes experiential learning opportunities and the option to complete a cooperative education experience.
Program name: Master of Sports Leadership

description: The PhD in Bioengineering program at Northeastern University prepares students to become leaders in bioengineering research and development. Students delve into advanced coursework and conduct original research that contributes to the scientific and engineering knowledge base. The program emphasizes interdisciplinary collaboration, innovation, and the application of engineering principles to solve complex problems in biology and medicine. Research opportunities span areas such as biomechanics, biomaterials, tissue engineering, neuroengineering, medical imaging, and computational bioengineering.
Program name: PhD in Bioengineering

description: Northeastern's PhD in chemical engineering emphasizes the development of novel solutions to global challenges within the context of basic sciences and engineering principles. Graduates are prepared for leadership careers in academia, industry, and government laboratories. This research-intensive program requires students to conduct original research that advances the fundamental understanding of chemical engineering processes and culminates in a dissertation. Students will work closely with faculty mentors, contributing to cutting-edge research in areas such as advanced materials, energy systems, biotechnology, environmental engineering, and process design and control. The curriculum includes advanced coursework in transport phenomena, thermodynamics, kinetics, and applied mathematics, alongside opportunities for interdisciplinary collaboration and professional development.
Program name: PhD in Chemical Engineering

description: The PhD in Economics at Northeastern University offers rigorous training in economic theory and econometrics, developing highly skilled, independent researchers. Our program offers strengths in both theoretical and applied aspects of microeconomics, macroeconomics, and econometrics. Our faculty conduct research in areas that include applied econometrics, behavioral economics, environmental and resource economics, health economics, industrial organization, international economics, labor economics, macroeconomics, public economics, and urban and regional economics. While the core curriculum is consistent with other top graduate programs in economics, our training is distinguished by an emphasis on empirical analysis and policy-relevant research.
Program name: PhD in Economics

description: The PhD in History program at Northeastern University offers rigorous, individualized training for students interested in pursuing academic careers, digital humanities, public history, and other professions that demand advanced historical research and analysis. Students tailor their work around their own research interests, in consultation with faculty in their areas of specialization. The program cultivates historians whose research and teaching are at the cutting edge of the discipline. Graduates of the program are prepared to contribute to current conversations across the academy and to engage publics beyond it. PhD students in History typically complete coursework in their first three years and dedicate themselves to research and writing for the remaining two years. The program consists of 60 semester hours of credit, including 10 courses beyond the master’s degree, plus teaching and independent research. Coursework includes a range of seminars, methods courses, and directed studies. After successfully completing comprehensive exams, students propose and then write a dissertation. All PhD students are expected to teach for at least four semesters as part of their training, typically as a teaching assistant for an introductory survey course or a research methods course. They are also expected to participate in the department’s many ongoing research and professional development workshops.
Program name: PhD in History

Concentration name: Operations Research, Manufacturing and Production Systems, Human Factors and Ergonomics, Supply Chain Management, Healthcare Systems Engineering, Data Analytics and Machine Learning
description: Welcome to the PhD Program in Industrial Engineering at Northeastern University! Our mission is to develop researchers and educators who can make significant contributions to the field of industrial engineering through innovative research, teaching, and service. This program is designed to provide students with advanced knowledge in industrial engineering principles, methodologies, and applications, as well as to equip them with the skills to conduct original and significant research. The IE PhD Program Goals are: To provide students with a solid foundation in industrial engineering and related fields through advanced coursework. To equip students with the skills to conduct original and significant research that advances the state-of-the-art in industrial engineering. To prepare students for careers in academia, industry, and government, where they can contribute to the development and application of industrial engineering principles.
Program name: PhD in Industrial Engineering

Concentration name: Marine Biology, Environmental Science and Policy
description: Northeastern’s Doctor of Philosophy (PhD) in Marine and Environmental Sciences is an interdisciplinary program that prepares students for research and teaching careers in academia, government, and industry. Our faculty’s expertise spans a range of fields, including: marine biology, ecology, oceanography, environmental science, conservation, environmental policy, and environmental health. Our researchers work locally and globally to understand and address pressing challenges, such as: climate change impacts on coastal ecosystems, sustainable fisheries management, conservation of endangered species, coastal ecosystem restoration, pollution in the marine environment, and the human health effects of environmental contaminants.
Program name: PhD in Marine and Environmental Sciences

description: Network Science is a rapidly growing interdisciplinary field that offers a comprehensive framework to study complex systems from a systems-level perspective. The field brings together elements from computer science, physics, sociology, and biology to analyze and model the structure and dynamics of interconnected systems. From social networks to biological networks and the internet, understanding these complex systems is crucial for addressing contemporary challenges across diverse domains, including technology, health, and society. The PhD in Network Science at Northeastern University provides students with a multidisciplinary education at the forefront of this emerging field. Our program is designed to equip students with the theoretical foundations, computational skills, and interdisciplinary perspective necessary to conduct cutting-edge research and become leaders in academia, industry, and government. Through rigorous coursework, hands-on research opportunities, and collaborations with world-renowned faculty, students will develop a deep understanding of network theory, data analysis techniques, and computational modeling. Graduates will be prepared to tackle complex real-world problems, contribute to theoretical advancements, and drive innovation in various fields where interconnected systems play a critical role.
Program name: PhD in Network Science

description: The PhD in Personal Health Informatics prepares students to conduct independent, interdisciplinary research at the intersection of health sciences, social sciences, and information sciences. Students develop a strong foundation in personal health informatics, including data acquisition, processing, analytics, and applications. They engage in cutting-edge research in a variety of areas, such as designing and evaluating mobile health interventions, developing intelligent systems for health behavior change, and analyzing large-scale health data for personalized recommendations. The program emphasizes a blend of theoretical knowledge and practical skills, preparing graduates for leadership roles in academia, research institutions, and industry.
Program name: PhD in Personal Health Informatics

description: The Doctor of Philosophy in Chemistry program at Northeastern University offers advanced study and research in various areas of chemistry. Students engage in rigorous coursework and cutting-edge research under the guidance of faculty mentors, leading to the completion of a dissertation. The program prepares graduates for careers in academia, industry, and government, with a strong foundation in chemical principles and experimental techniques. Areas of research include, but are not limited to, analytical, biological, inorganic, organic, physical, and theoretical chemistry, as well as chemical biology and materials chemistry. Students are expected to develop strong critical thinking, problem-solving, and communication skills throughout their studies.
Program name: PhD in Chemistry

description: The Doctor of Philosophy (PhD) in Civil and Environmental Engineering is designed for students seeking to conduct original research and advance knowledge in a specialized area of civil and environmental engineering. The PhD program offers a broad range of research opportunities within the various areas of specialization, including construction management, environmental engineering, geotechnical engineering, structural engineering, transportation engineering, and water resources engineering. Faculty expertise and state-of-the-art research facilities support a wide range of analytical, experimental, and computational studies related to resilient infrastructure, smart cities, sustainable systems, and human health. The PhD program prepares graduates for careers in academia, industry, and government research.
Program name: PhD in Civil and Environmental Engineering

description: As one of the fastest growing fields in the country, Computer Engineering prepares students for careers in the high-tech industry as well as research and development. In the PhD in Computer Engineering program, students conduct original research in advanced computer engineering topics and gain specialized training to become leaders in industry and academia. The program emphasizes a balance between hardware and software, and theory and practice, encompassing subjects such as VLSI, embedded systems, computer architecture, computer networks, distributed systems, information assurance, bioinformatics, and machine learning.
Program name: PhD in Computer Engineering

description: The PhD in Computer Science program at Northeastern University prepares students for careers in research and education. Our faculty are at the forefront of the field, leading research in areas such as artificial intelligence, data science, cybersecurity, and human-computer interaction. As a PhD student, you will work closely with a faculty advisor to conduct original research, publish your findings in top-tier venues, and contribute to the advancement of computer science.
Program name: PhD in Computer Science

description: With a focus on social justice and health equity, the PhD in Counseling Psychology program at Northeastern University’s Bouvé College of Health Sciences trains graduate students to become counseling psychologists who are highly skilled in clinical practice, research, advocacy, and teaching. Our program, located in Boston, Massachusetts, prepares graduates for a variety of roles within academia and healthcare settings. The PhD in Counseling Psychology program is a full-time, in-person doctoral program that includes a minimum of four years of academic coursework, clinical practicum, research, and a 1-year full-time internship. Students typically take five to six years to complete the program. Graduates of our program are eligible for licensure as psychologists in most states and are well-prepared for careers in university teaching, research, and administration; community mental health centers; medical centers; private practice; and other health service psychology settings. Upon completion of this program, you’ll be prepared to: Provide multiculturally competent and evidence-based clinical services, including assessment, diagnosis, and intervention; Conduct scholarly research in areas aligned with the program’s social justice and health equity focus, including publishing in peer-reviewed journals and presenting at professional conferences; Advocate for marginalized communities and promote systemic change through social justice initiatives; Teach and supervise future generations of counseling psychologists; Engage in lifelong learning and professional development.
Accreditation status: The PhD in Counseling Psychology program is accredited by the Commission on Accreditation of the American Psychological Association (APA).
Program name: PhD in Counseling Psychology

description: The PhD program in Criminology and Justice Policy offers students the opportunity to learn from leading scholars who are committed to both rigorous academic research and policy-relevant scholarship. The program’s unique approach emphasizes the interdisciplinary nature of criminology and justice studies, and its strong connection to urban issues, human behavior, and the processes of social and institutional change. This research-intensive program provides students with the methodological, analytical, and theoretical skills to develop independent, impactful scholarship in the field. Students will acquire the analytical and methodological expertise necessary to engage in high-impact scholarship on crime and justice, and will develop their skills as researchers and teachers to ultimately become future leaders in the field, whether in academia, government, or policy-related positions.
Program name: PhD in Criminology and Justice Policy
PhD in Cybersecurity

description: The PhD in Pharmaceutics and Drug Delivery program aims to provide students with a solid foundation in the fundamental principles of pharmaceutics and drug delivery, as well as the opportunity to conduct cutting-edge research in these areas. The program prepares graduates for careers in academia, the pharmaceutical and biotechnology industries, and government. Students will gain expertise in various aspects of drug development, including drug formulation, pharmacokinetics, biopharmaceutics, and drug delivery systems. The curriculum emphasizes both theoretical knowledge and practical skills, enabling students to design, execute, and interpret experiments related to drug discovery and development. Graduates will be equipped to address complex challenges in drug delivery and contribute to the advancement of pharmaceutical sciences.
Program name: PhD in Pharmaceutics and Drug Delivery

description: The PhD in Pharmacology program at Northeastern University’s Bouvé College of Health Sciences offers a strong foundation in contemporary biomedical sciences. Our faculty conducts cutting-edge research in drug discovery and development, cancer biology, neuropharmacology, molecular and biochemical pharmacology, cardiovascular pharmacology, and immunology. Students in our program gain expertise in a broad range of scientific areas and acquire knowledge and skills to lead a successful career in academia, pharmaceutical industries, or government agencies. Students learn how to design and conduct hypothesis-driven research, critically evaluate scientific literature, and effectively communicate their research findings to a diverse audience.
Program name: PhD in Pharmacology

description: Northeastern’s PhD in Physics program emphasizes experimental, theoretical, and computational research across a broad spectrum of physics. Students explore the core topics of classical mechanics, electromagnetism, quantum mechanics, and statistical mechanics. With faculty committed to both outstanding instruction and cutting-edge research, doctoral students are prepared to conduct independent research, write and defend a thesis, and become leaders in their fields. Students also have access to state-of-the-art facilities and equipment, including a particle accelerator, high-performance computing clusters, and a materials characterization lab.
Program name: PhD in Physics

description: Northeastern’s PhD in Political Science offers an innovative, rigorous, interdisciplinary approach to the study of politics and public policy. Our program leverages the university’s strengths in urban and public policy, global studies, security studies, law, and data science, with a distinctive focus on preparing students for careers as both academics and policy-oriented researchers. The curriculum provides students with a strong foundation in theory and methods while also allowing them to tailor their research to specific interests. Our faculty members work at the frontiers of their fields, producing cutting-edge research and engaging in public discourse. With this foundation, students pursue a rigorous course of study to become experts in their fields, contribute to scholarly and public debates, and conduct independent research.
Program name: PhD in Political Science
PhD in Population Health

description: Northeastern University offers a PhD in Psychology, with research training in five focus areas: behavioral neuroscience, clinical psychology, cognitive psychology, developmental psychology, or social psychology. The PhD program offers a broad-based education in psychological science and prepares students for research and teaching positions in academia and for research and applied positions in industry and government. Doctoral students conduct research in collaboration with faculty in one of five focus areas: behavioral neuroscience, clinical psychology, cognitive psychology, developmental psychology, or social psychology. The department has a commitment to an inclusive academic environment and welcomes a diverse community of scholars to its PhD program. For students in the clinical psychology program, successful completion of the PhD degree is a prerequisite for entry into the clinical internship. The clinical psychology program is accredited by the American Psychological Association (APA). Upon completion of the PhD program in Psychology, students will be able to: Demonstrate knowledge of the current scientific literature in their chosen areas of specialization as well as the broader field of psychology. Formulate testable hypotheses and research questions and design appropriate studies to address them. Collect, analyze, and interpret data using appropriate statistical and methodological techniques. Communicate research findings effectively in both oral and written formats to scientific and general audiences. Adhere to ethical principles in the conduct of psychological research and professional practice. Apply psychological theories and research findings to real-world problems and contribute to the advancement of psychological science.
Accreditation status: The clinical psychology program is accredited by the American Psychological Association (APA).
Program name: PhD in Psychology

description:
The Doctor of Philosophy in Public Policy at Northeastern University prepares students to become leading researchers and scholars who will advance the public good through careers in academia, government, and the non-profit sector.
Graduates of the program conduct high-quality research that can inform public policy decisions at the local, state, federal, and global levels. You will gain a deep understanding of current policy debates and the policymaking process, advanced skills in policy analysis and research methods, and a strong foundation in policy theory.
The PhD program in Public Policy is based in Northeastern’s College of Professional Studies and draws upon the strength of the university’s interdisciplinary faculty, with expertise in public policy, political science, economics, data science, law, and urban affairs. The program emphasizes a blend of theoretical understanding and practical application, ensuring that graduates are well-equipped to address complex policy challenges.
Program name: PhD in Public Policy

description: The Experiential AI Leadership graduate certificate, formerly called the Experiential PhD Leadership graduate certificate, is designed for current PhD students at Northeastern University and early career researchers in academia and industry to explore foundational concepts in data science, machine learning, and artificial intelligence, and how to apply these concepts in an interdisciplinary context with an emphasis on ethics, privacy, and trustworthy AI. The curriculum covers both theoretical understanding and practical applications of AI tools, culminating in an experiential project to provide a hands-on opportunity to apply the learned knowledge. The Experiential AI Leadership graduate certificate helps students and researchers develop leadership skills in guiding interdisciplinary teams and ethical, impactful research in an increasingly data-driven world. The certificate is offered by the College of Computer and Information Science and aligns with the goals of Northeastern’s Experiential PhD program. It is also suitable for students outside the Experiential PhD program who are interested in developing expertise and leadership in AI and data science.
Program name: Graduate Certificate in Experiential PhD Leadership

description: The graduate certificate in Global Doctoral Research prepares doctoral students from any discipline to engage with global dimensions of their research. Recognizing the increasing prevalence of global research in all fields, this certificate provides students with theoretical, methodological, and ethical frameworks that are necessary to conduct impactful, responsible, and ethical global research. The certificate also supports students in developing a broad range of transferable professional skills including cross-cultural communication, intercultural competencies, navigating international research collaborations, and project management. The curriculum is designed to support PhD students across all disciplines to develop these skills through experiential learning opportunities. The certificate is offered by the Graduate School of Education within the College of Professional Studies, and delivered in a hybrid format, with both online and in-person offerings.
Program name: Graduate Certificate in Global Doctoral Research

description: The Graduate Certificate in Postsecondary Teaching is a 15-semester-hour program for those who want to teach in postsecondary education settings such as community colleges, four-year colleges, and universities. The program is ideal for individuals with a master’s degree or higher in a content area who are interested in developing pedagogical skills. The curriculum includes courses related to understanding postsecondary learners, designing instruction, developing curriculum, assessing learning, and exploring teaching as a profession. This certificate is also appropriate for faculty currently teaching in higher education who wish to enhance their teaching effectiveness.
Program name: Graduate Certificate in Postsecondary Teaching

description: The 3D Animation graduate certificate program provides students with the fundamental knowledge and techniques to effectively use 3D modeling and animation software, such as Autodesk Maya, and gain professional experience within the expanding field of animation. You’ll learn how to develop a strong artistic foundation in traditional and current 3D production techniques. This includes modeling, lighting, texturing, rigging, rendering, and compositing, as well as character animation and motion capture. Throughout the program, you’ll build a professional portfolio to showcase your expertise in the animation industry.
Program name: Certificate in 3-D Animation

description:
Accelerate your accounting career with the Northeastern University D’Amore-McKim School of Business Master of Science in Accounting (MS) program. Whether you’re a recent college graduate or a seasoned professional looking to prepare for the CPA exam and pivot into the accounting field, our master’s in accounting program can prepare you with the specialized skills you need for success. You will gain a deep understanding of financial accounting, taxation, auditing, and other essential accounting practices, while developing the data analytics, communication, and leadership skills that are essential in today’s evolving business landscape. In addition, our master’s in accounting program is STEM-designated, providing international students with an extended Optional Practical Training (OPT) period.
This program offers multiple learning options: Full-time or Part-time. In addition, you can pursue the Master of Science in Accounting with a concentration in Analytics or Financial Reporting.
Program name: Master's in Accounting

description: This 12-semester-hour program is designed for students with an undergraduate business degree or other relevant undergraduate degrees who want to develop or refresh their accounting and financial knowledge and decision-making skills in preparation for entry into or advancement within a variety of business fields or for application to a graduate degree program in business. Students will acquire specialized knowledge in financial accounting, managerial accounting, corporate finance, and financial statement analysis.
Program name: Certificate in Accounting and Financial Decision Making

description: The Master’s in Accounting/MBA program at Northeastern University combines the knowledge, skills, and values of the accounting profession with a broad understanding of the functional areas of business. The dual degree combines the Master of Science in Accounting with the Master of Business Administration. Offered through the D’Amore-McKim School of Business, this program is designed for aspiring leaders interested in a wide range of accounting and financial careers in corporations, financial services, public accounting, and non-profit organizations. It prepares graduates for managerial roles and leadership positions in the accounting field, equipping them with both specialized accounting expertise and a comprehensive business perspective. The curriculum delves into advanced accounting principles, financial reporting, auditing, taxation, and business analytics, complemented by core MBA subjects like finance, marketing, operations, and strategy. The program emphasizes experiential learning, including co-op opportunities, allowing students to apply classroom knowledge in real-world settings and build professional networks. Graduates are well-prepared for careers in public accounting, corporate finance, consulting, and other business sectors, with a strong foundation for professional certifications such as the CPA (Certified Public Accountant) exam.
Program name: Master's in Accounting/MBA

description: The Master of Science in Nursing (MSN) Adult-Gerontology Acute Care Nurse Practitioner (AG-ACNP) program is designed for registered nurses who want to advance their careers and become board-certified Adult-Gerontology Acute Care Nurse Practitioners. The program prepares students to provide advanced nursing care to patients with complex acute and chronic health conditions across the adult-gerontology lifespan. As an AG-ACNP, you will specialize in providing direct care to acutely and critically ill adults and older adults in various settings, including hospitals, intensive care units, emergency departments, specialty clinics, and long-term care facilities. You will collaborate with interprofessional healthcare teams to manage patient care, order and interpret diagnostic tests, prescribe medications, and perform procedures. The curriculum focuses on developing advanced assessment, diagnostic, and therapeutic skills, as well as a strong foundation in evidence-based practice, patient safety, and healthcare policy. Graduates of the AG-ACNP program are eligible to sit for national certification exams offered by the American Nurses Credentialing Center (ANCC) or the American Association of Critical-Care Nurses (AACN). Overall, the AG-ACNP program at Northeastern University provides comprehensive education and clinical training to prepare advanced practice nurses to meet the growing demand for highly skilled healthcare providers in acute and critical care settings.
Accreditation status: Accredited by the Commission on Collegiate Nursing Education (CCNE).
Program name: Master's in Adult-Gerontology Acute Care Nursing
Certificate in Adult-Gerontology Acute Care Nursing
Certificate in Adult-Gerontology Primary Care Nursing

description: The Master of Science in Advanced and Intelligent Manufacturing (MS AIM) program prepares students to become leaders in the evolving field of manufacturing. The program focuses on equipping students with advanced knowledge and skills in intelligent manufacturing systems, automation, digital twin technology, data analytics, and artificial intelligence applied to manufacturing processes. Graduates will be prepared to design, implement, and manage advanced manufacturing systems, driving innovation and efficiency in various industries.
Program name: Master's in Advanced and Intelligent Manufacturing

description: The Agile Project Management graduate certificate provides students with the fundamental knowledge and skills needed to manage and lead projects in a fast-paced environment where change is constant. Upon completion of the program, students will have an understanding of Agile principles and methodologies, including Scrum, Kanban, and Lean, as well as the ability to apply these practices to real-world projects. This certificate is ideal for professionals seeking to enhance their project management capabilities, transition into Agile roles, or pursue careers in project management, business analysis, or product ownership.
Program name: Certificate in Agile Project Management

description: The Certificate in AI Applications at Northeastern University is designed for professionals who want to develop practical skills in artificial intelligence and its applications across various industries. This program provides a strong foundation in AI principles and techniques, focusing on hands-on experience with real-world AI projects. Through hands-on projects, students gain real-world experience and develop skills in areas such as machine learning, natural language processing, computer vision, and deep learning. Students will also learn about the ethical considerations and societal impacts of AI applications, ensuring they are prepared to develop and deploy AI solutions responsibly. The curriculum covers key areas such as machine learning, deep learning, natural language processing, and computer vision. Students will learn how to design, implement, and deploy AI solutions using popular tools and frameworks. The program emphasizes ethical considerations and societal impacts of AI, ensuring graduates are well-rounded professionals capable of developing responsible AI applications.
Program name: Certificate in AI Applications
